title: Retire the run/reconcile/wave/closeout prompts and phase table from the sandbox entrypoint
description: From ticfac yoh finding 93b6bea0 (dl8, 2026-09-24). ticfac no longer boots a container whose harness orchestrates (yoh's dl8 deleted that path; ticfac runs run-epic in the container, and the Workflow only supervises). cloud/sandbox/entrypoint.sh still carries the run/reconcile/wave/closeout prompts and the phase table only that path reached.
